I felt it was important to leave a review following my experience with this practice and the way a formal complaint was handled.

I initially attended with a clear description of my symptoms and concerns, but I was not properly examined and my concerns were repeatedly dismissed. Despite explaining from the outset what I believed was wrong, I was dismissed on multiple occasions for around a month without appropriate investigation or treatment. When I tried to challenge this, I was told I should simply trust what the GP had said.

My condition deteriorated during that time and I ended up being hospitalised and requiring surgery a month later. I was told it had become extremely serious and could have progressed to sepsis, despite only a few days prior the GP saying there was nothing wrong with me, despite not even examining me to see how badly my condition had deteriorated.

After raising serious concerns about the care I received, the response I was given was that the GP involved had reviewed their own actions and concluded that nothing was done incorrectly. This does not constitute an independent or impartial review, and it left me with very little confidence in the practice’s complaints process.

Having read other reviews and speaking to other patients of the practise, this is clearly a repeated behaviour by the GP/GPs that work there (of which there are only 2).

Do not join this practise. Categorically.",null,[0,138]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toNU9WcHlaVXRDV1V4aVJtdGtjMUpuVkRWM1FXYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xd25641f90304d1c7!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOkh5OVpyZUtCWUxiRmtkc1JnVDV3QWc%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2toNU9WcHlaVXRDV1V4aVJtdGtjMUpuVkRWM1FXYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwiuq_2F4bGTAxXwR4QGHTR-CZkQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwiuq_2F4bGTAxXwR4QGHTR-CZkQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESYENBRVFBUnBDUTJrNFNVRlNTVzVEWjI5QlVEY3lSMDFKYlRnNFVGOWZSV2hFZVZrNVNUVnpTR1pOZW1RNU5EaFFORUZCUVVGQlIyZG1YMEZ0VFVsdE9EaFFSMEZCYVVGQg=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21wb1gxUjVMVTVVZG01MmJVOTNZemhGU1ZseVQwRRAB",["0x0:0xd25641f90304d1c7",null,1770631926011601,1770631926011601,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/105978974978552376638/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Lionel
